author: Ryan George Extra Plus!
description:
I’m back. I haven’t made a video in a while BECAUSE I WAS SAD , but I’ve decided that being paralyzed by sadness for the rest of my life is probably not the best business model. So, we’re returning to the series where I look at the absolute weirdest news stories the internet has to offer, just beyond your front door by a number of miles, depending on your current geographic location.
